answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks with a bonded attestation registry. Each agent locks a stake before its wallet may harbor a vote, and peers leave a crystal audit trail of unique-identity vouchers that count only once per bond. Rewards scale with distinct staked vouchers, so every forged identity needs its own bond and paid voucher. Collusion found in that trail lands in a sable dossier and slashes the whole stake, so the attacker's bill outruns any per-identity payout.
